title: How do I create an automatic multi-angle shot of an object?
h1: How to create a multi-angle and automated shot of an object? 🤖
description: Learn how to create a multi-angle shot of an object with the Alphashot PRO G2 automated photo studio. A simple tutorial for visuals produced internally in a few minutes.
tool: Orbitvu Station software and an art object
introText:
The presentation Multi angles of your products on your website is essential and the production of these visuals can be facilitated thanks to automation. 🤖

In this tutorial, we'll guide you step-by-step to capture photos from different angles using the Alphashot PRO G2

Here we are using an art object as an example, but this method also applies to technical products, handcrafted or collectible.

Thanks to the interface ofOrbitvu Station and multi-view templates, you will gain in precision, consistency and rapidity. ⏳

Also discover how to make a 360 video of your statue for immersive content.

steps.title: Positioning the object
steps.content:
The first step is to place the object in the center of the turntable. The Alphashot PRO G2 is equipped with a centering laser, which allows you to position the object with precision. 📍

For fragile objects or objects that could move during the rotation of the tray, you can use fixing paste or double-sided invisible tape to stabilize without altering the aesthetics.

Make sure the camera is properly positioned at the desired angle.

Make sure the camera is properly positioned at the desired angle.

steps.title: Set up the light with the help of AI
steps.content:
This studio has a AI Assistant, a technology that automatically recognizes the characteristics of the object placed in the studio. 💡

Click on theThe “AI” icon and it offers several adapted light configurations. You can choose one and fine-tune the settings manually. 📂
steps.structuredText: This studio has an AI Assistant, a technology that automatically recognizes the characteristics of the object placed in the studio. Click on the “AI” icon and it offers you several adapted light configurations. You can choose one and fine-tune the settings manually.

steps.title: Activate IQ Mask for automatic clipping
steps.content:
Activate the function IQ Mask, it allows you to automatically crop the object on a white or transparent background. To get the perfect clipping, adjust the light level. Your object should be darker than the background. Anything that is still clear will be removed.

✨ Tip : Play on the panels at the back and on the turntable to create a light in the opposite direction of your object which will make it appear darker.

‍

steps.title: Program the shooting angles
steps.content:
With the Orbitvu Station software, you can program shooting multiple shots at predefined angles.

For example, you may decide to capture the object at 0°, 45°, 45°, 90°, 135°, and 180°... To do this, choose your angles by clicking outside in the wheel to fix shooting points as in the photo.

Once the angles are set, the turntable automatically adjusts to each position, triggers the shot, and then moves on to the next without manual intervention. 🤖

You can also save this configuration as a reusable template, which is ideal for creating a coherent set of visuals at scale. 📂

steps.title: Capture and process your images
steps.content:
When everything is ready, simply click on “Capture everything” in Orbitvu Station. 📷

The studio is going to run the entire sequence. Once the images have been captured, you can consult them, sort them, and edit them if necessary via built-in post-processing options. 🎨
steps.structuredText: When everything is ready, simply click “Capture All” in Orbitvu Station. The studio is going to run the entire sequence. Once captured, you can review, sort, and edit images as needed using built-in post-processing options.

steps.title: Export your visuals and share them
steps.content:
Finally, you can export your images from the tab “Publish” and choose the export format JPEG for the web, PNG with transparency, WEPB, TIF... 📤

You can also publish your photos from the software directly on your social networks or on a marketplace like Shopify or Magento. 💻

faqs.question: Is the Alphashot PRO G2 suitable for photography or video beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Alphashot PRO G2 is designed to be accessible even to users with no prior photography experience. Thanks to its AI assistant and its predefined light templates, it automates a large part of the complex settings, allowing a quick and intuitive handling.

faqs.question: What types of objects can be photographed or filmed with the Alphashot PRO G2?
faqs.answer: The Alphashot PRO G2 is designed to capture small to medium sized objects, such as cosmetics, eyeglasses, or decorative objects. It can also manage various surfaces (matt, shiny) thanks to its 74 adjustable light sources.

faqs.question: How can the Alphashot PRO G2 help a business reduce professional photography costs?
faqs.answer: The Alphashot PRO G2 reduces professional photography costs by automating the entire process from shooting to post-production, reducing the need for specialized labor and accelerating content creation.

faqs.question: What types of output files does the Alphashot Pro G2 generate?
faqs.answer: The Alphashot PRO G2 allows you to export images in JPEG, PNG, PNG, TIFF, TIFF, AVIF, WEBP... as well as 360° animations in HTML5 and videos in MP4, offering great flexibility for various platforms and uses.

faqs.question: Is there an integrated focus stacking function to obtain optimal sharpness on highly detailed objects or objects with complex reliefs?
faqs.answer: Yes, a focus stacking function is available to capture multiple areas of focus and combine them automatically. This makes it possible to obtain a completely clear image over the entire surface of the object, even if it has many reliefs or fine details.
